steps.en: Review and copy the selected skill into project scope with its notice
steps.zh: 审阅选定技能，连同许可通知放进项目

steps.en: Supply an authorized static frame, context and requested deliverables
steps.zh: 提供有权使用的静态稿、场景和交付要求

steps.en: Direct the agent to rebuild and compare the still before motion
steps.zh: 指导agent先复建并核对静帧

steps.en: Review the live page before the first recording
steps.zh: 首次录制前审看实际页面

steps.en: Describe the clock, story loops, frame checks and media export
steps.zh: 指导单时钟、故事循环、逐帧检查与媒体导出

value.en: A source-aware showcase procedure instead of a generic screenshot entrance
value.zh: 按源稿制作展示流程，而不只是让整张截图滑入
